name: ARA4050
title: Glyph atlas request invalid
summary: A glyph or atlas request is outside the supported limits: atlas size outside 64-4096, a glyph larger than an atlas page, or a scalable glyph without an outline.
html:
A glyph or atlas request is outside the supported limits: atlas size outside 64-4096, a glyph larger than an atlas page, or a scalable glyph without an outline.

#Common causes

  • A very large font size.
  • A corrupt font.

#Fixes

  • Use a larger atlas or a smaller raster scale; replace the font.

  • Code: ARA4050

  • Constant: ui::ATLAS

  • Reported by: ara-ui-render
